items.text: Our group website is online. Welcome!
items.text_zh: 研究组网站正式上线，欢迎关注！

items.text: Dr. Fan presented our work on neurodevelopmental epicenters in schizophrenia at an international conference.
items.text_zh: 樊云霜博士关于精神分裂症神经发育震中的研究在国际会议上进行展示。

items.text: We are recruiting Master's and PhD students with backgrounds in biomedical engineering, computer science or neuroscience.
items.text_zh: 课题组常年招收硕士、博士研究生，欢迎生物医学工程、计算机、神经科学等背景的同学加入。
